'''Snapshade''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Budboo]] at 6 bronze stars/19 copies, and evolves into [[Thornwisp]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Snapshade was supposed to be temporary decor when the party ran out of flowers, but ended up sticking around. Oof! Do plants usually try to trip every Tatari passing by?"

Snapshade is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Snapshade's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Thornwisp]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Snapshade to increase its stats 3 times.
* Shoot 20,000 pinballs.

== Trivia ==
* Snapshade and its evolutions were added to the game on 7/29/2026 alongside [[Kaiseroo]] and [[Saberheart]].
